posts.text:
Best part of scaring of AI reply bots is that now everyone can reply to my posts again

Before I had to lock it to "only people who my followers follow can reply"

I like to have everyone reply and AI reply bots were ruining that too! https://t.co/T4G7v6nR7y
posts.text_zh:
把 AI 回复机器人吓跑之后，最棒的一点是现在大家又都能回复我的帖子了

以前我只能把回复权限锁成「仅我关注者所关注的人可回复」

我希望所有人都能回复，但 AI 回复机器人也把这件事搞砸了！ https://t.co/T4G7v6nR7y

posts.text:
I paid $300 for a 15+ year old Sony camcorder that was probably collecting dust in someone’s garage. 

Best thing I bought this year.

In a world of brainrot and infinite scroll, I think millions of people want physical, tactile things again. https://t.co/DPcAHGqaIe
posts.text_zh:
我花了 300 美元买了一台有 15 年以上历史的 Sony 摄像机，它大概之前一直在某人家车库里吃灰。

这是我今年买过最值的东西。

在这个满是脑腐内容和无限滚动的世界里，我觉得有几百万人又开始想要实体的、能亲手触摸的东西了。 https://t.co/DPcAHGqaIe
